headline: Profit climbs on expense discipline as margin narrows
summary_short: Diluted EPS rose to $2.35, up 11.4% y/y, as a 6.9% y/y net income gain and a 4.1% smaller diluted share count outran a 24bp y/y narrowing in net interest margin to 3.78%.
summary_long: Net income of $230.0M (+6.9% y/y) reflected a $9.9M rise in noninterest income and a $17.3M drop in noninterest expense (fewer merger/restructuring costs from the 2025 Independent acquisition), partly offset by an $8.4M higher credit-loss provision on stronger loan growth ($5.2B production, +$1.4B net growth). The efficiency ratio improved to 50.0% from 52.7% y/y. Net interest margin compressed to 3.78% (non-TE) from 4.02% y/y on lower loan yields and reduced accretion income, partially offset by lower funding costs. Shareholders' equity rose to $9,131.5M on retained earnings, net of $117.2M in H1 dividends and $249.0M in H1 buybacks. CET1 ratio was 11.12% at quarter-end. No forward guidance was issued in the filing.

drivers.explanation: Company attributes the y/y EPS gain to higher noninterest income, lower noninterest expense (fading Independent-merger costs), and fewer average shares outstanding, partly offset by margin compression and a higher provision.

A $9.9M rise in noninterest income and a $17.3M decline in noninterest expense drove the gain, partly offset by an $8.4M higher provision for credit losses tied to stronger loan production and net growth.
Reflects the 6.9% net income increase plus a 4.1% reduction in average basic shares from the Company's ongoing stock buyback plan (~4.9M shares repurchased since June 30, 2025).
Cash funded loan growth of $2.2 billion and a $205.7 million increase in investment securities during H1 2026, per the Capital Resources / Liquidity discussion.
H1 2026 net income of $455.8M was partly offset by $117.2M of dividends paid and $249.0M of open-market share repurchases, per the Capital Resources section.
Declined as the Company repurchased 2,500,000 shares (1,000,000 in Q2 alone) under its 2026 Repurchase Plan at a weighted average price of $99.58.
